w10_P4_001855: The final energy figure in a test log, in J, is 22 J of stored spring energy added to an adjusted value. The adjusted value is 20 J of sensor offset added to the energy of motion of a 20 kg sled. The sled moves at a speed in m/s equal to 18 less than the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 13. The sled track is 250 m long. What is the final figure, in J?
w10_P4_001859: The value a technician finally records, in kJ, is 16 kJ less than a subtotal. The subtotal is 25 kJ of battery reserve added to the energy of motion of a 10 kg cart, after that energy has been converted to kJ. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to 7 times the greatest common divisor of 351 and 373. The cart's wheels are 12 cm in diameter. What value does the technician record, in kJ?
w10_P4_001866: The final entry on a launch-rig checklist is a thrust figure in N. It is 9 N more than the force needed to accelerate a 27 kg payload at a certain rate. That rate, in m/s², is 27 more than 12 times the area under the curve y = 5x² + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. What is the final entry, in N?
w10_P4_001867: The number at the bottom of a rail-depot energy sheet, in J, is 29 J less than a daily total. The daily total is 10 times a per-run figure. The per-run figure is 3 J less than the combined energy of motion of 5 identical trolleys. Each trolley has a mass of 17 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 4x² at the point x = 1. What number is at the bottom of the sheet, in J?
w10_P4_001874: A 104,000 g block on a test rig is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 4x² + 5x between x = 0 and x = 2. The force needed for this, less 9 N supplied by a spring, is the actuator force. The actuator force is converted to kN. The rig log then records the actuator force minus a 30 kN clamping load, with the actuator direction positive, so the entry may be negative. What does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_001877: The final line of a press-test sheet is a net force in kN, found by subtracting 30 kN of return-spring load from an earlier net figure, with the pressing direction taken as positive. That earlier figure was a combined ram force with 24 kN of frame resistance subtracted. The combined ram force, expressed in kN, is that of 5 identical rams acting together. Each ram supplies the force needed to accelerate a 40 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to 5 times the sum of 8 and 8. What net force is on the final line, in kN?
w10_P4_001879: A 79,000 g pallet on a warehouse lift is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. Each of the lift's 8 hoist motors is rated to supply the full force needed for this, and the controller sums the 8 ratings. The sum is converted to kN. The site has 3 such lifts, so the site figure is 3 times the per-lift value, and 28 kN of structural allowance is then added. What is the site figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001881: The final value on a drone-motor test sheet is a thrust expressed in kN. It is obtained by converting to kN a force that was built up as follows: 24 N of margin was added to a subtotal, and that subtotal was 15 N of gust allowance added to a net thrust. The net thrust was the force needed to accelerate a 5 kg drone at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 8, less 29 N of lift contributed by ground effect. What is the final value, in kN?
w10_P4_001883: A 36,000 g cart rolls at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 345 and 321. Two such carts are coupled, so their combined energy of motion is twice that of one cart. From the combined value, 9 J of coupling loss is subtracted. The line runs 11 such pairs per shift and 3 shifts per day, so the daily figure is the per-pair value multiplied by 11 and then by 3. What is the daily figure, in J?
w10_P4_001889: A 92,000 g sled on a rocket track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the greatest common divisor of 70 and 343. The thrust required for this is supplied by each of 11 identical boosters, and the range sums the 11 outputs. From that sum, 19 N of rail friction is subtracted. Then 11 N of air drag is subtracted. What is the resulting thrust, in N?
w10_P4_001891: The figure at the end of a rail-car test report, in kJ, is 28 kJ of reserve added to a net energy that is expressed in kJ. The net energy is 7 J less than the energy of motion of a 58,000 g test car. The car moves at a speed in m/s equal to 12 more than 4 times the sum of 8 and 3. What figure ends the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_001901: A 164,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 9. The drive must supply the force for this, plus 8 N of roller friction, plus a further 17 N of belt tension. A 4 N assist from a slight downward incline is then subtracted. What force must the drive supply, in N?
w10_P4_001908: The total in a delivery-fleet energy report, in J, is 7 times a weekly figure. The weekly figure is 3 times a daily figure. The daily figure is 3 J more than the combined energy of motion of 4 identical cargo trikes. Each trike has a mass of 39 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 1·x² at the point x = 2. What is the total in the report, in J?
w10_P4_001912: The figure a lab reports, in J, is 6 times a single-run figure. The single-run figure is obtained from the energy of motion of a 16,000 g cart by subtracting 29 J of rail friction, then 21 J of air drag, then 7 J of sensor loss. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. What figure does the lab report, in J?
w10_P4_001920: A 195,000 g beam on a construction hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The hoisting force needed for this is converted to kN. Nine such hoists lift together, so the combined figure is 9 times that value. A 25 kN dead-load allowance is added, and then 16 kN of counterweight assist is subtracted. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001929: A 23,000 g test drone flies at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 3 rotors from a set of 7. Its energy of motion, plus 1 J of sensor offset, is converted to kJ. The fleet has 11 drones per hangar and 6 hangars. The fleet figure is therefore the per-drone value multiplied by 11 and then by 6. What is the fleet figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001930: The figure a test engineer finally quotes, in kN, is 6 kN of margin added to a combined force that is expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 4 identical thrusters acting together. Each thruster supplies the force needed to accelerate a 164,000 g sled at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 12. What figure does the engineer quote, in kN?
w10_P4_001935: The final entry in a launcher log is a net force in kN, defined as a combined thrust expressed in kN minus a 6 kN restraint load, with the launch direction positive, so it may be negative. The combined thrust is that of 9 identical launchers. Each launcher supplies the force needed to accelerate a 12,000 g projectile at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 10, less 23 N that a spring contributes. What is the final entry, in kN?
w10_P4_001939: A 118 kg tool carriage is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the sum of 7 and 2. The force required for this is converted to kN. The carriage rail is 9 m long. A 13 kN structural allowance is added, and then 3 kN of counterweight assist is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001940: The total force in a stamping-plant report, in N, is 6 times a line total. The line total is 12 times a single-press force. A single press supplies the force needed to accelerate a 140 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to 9 times the larger root of x² - 3x + 2 = 0. What is the total force in the report, in N?
w10_P4_001941: A 36 kg robot chassis on a factory floor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The floor is 60 m long. There are 10 robots per cell and 10 cells, so the factory figure is the per-robot value multiplied by 10 and then by 10 again. What is the factory figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001950: A 15,000 g tool head on a milling machine is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 15 more than the area under y = 1·x² + 6x between x = 3 and x = 4. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The machine log records a net force defined as that value minus a 19 kN clamping load plus a 15 kN hydraulic assist, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_001952: A cyclist and bike with a combined mass of 55,000 g ride at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 riders from a squad of 8. A team of 8 such riders has a combined energy of motion 8 times that of one rider. Four teams race, so the race figure is 4 times the team figure. From the race figure, 13 J of timing-gate loss is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in J?
w10_P4_001953: The last line of a sled-test log is a net force in kN, obtained by subtracting 13 kN of drag-chute load from an earlier figure, with the thrust direction positive, so it may be negative. That earlier figure was a thrust expressed in kN with 19 kN of rail-brake load subtracted. The thrust is the force needed to accelerate a 119 kg sled at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 2x² + 8x between x = 3 and x = 4. The track is 1.2 km long. What net force is on the last line, in kN?
w10_P4_001961: The figure at the bottom of a crane load sheet, in kN, is 9 kN of wind allowance added to a three-hoist total. The three-hoist total is 3 times a single-hoist net force expressed in kN. The single-hoist net force is 19 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 134 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 0x between x = 0 and x = 4. What figure is at the bottom of the load sheet, in kN?
